buyerSummary: Embroidered fabric patches designed for phone cases and tech accessories — removable, collectible and available with adhesive or magnetic backing.
overviewParagraphs: Embroidered phone case patches are small fabric patches designed to attach to phone cases, tablet covers, bags and other tech accessories. They offer the classic raised embroidery texture in a compact, collectible format.
With adhesive or magnetic backing, they are removable and swappable, making them popular for brand merchandise, creator collaborations and collectible accessory lines.

faqs.question: What is the MOQ for phone case patches?
faqs.answer: MOQ: 200 pcs per design and construction for bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I request a pre-production sample?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production sample development is available for custom projects so you can verify size, backing and stitch quality before bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I submit an inquiry without final artwork?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can submit your project now and send artwork later, or provide a reference image for our team to review.

faqs.question: What design files can I send?
faqs.answer: PNG, JPG, PDF, AI or SVG files work well. Clear color references help us match your thread colors accurately.

faqs.question: Can you help choose the right backing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Adhesive and magnetic backings suit phone cases, while sew-on backing suits fabric and textile applications.

faqs.question: Can you provide test reports?
faqs.answer: Test reports and compliance documentation can be supported according to selected materials, product construction and destination-market requirements.

faqs.question: How are phone case patches packed and shipped?
faqs.answer: Individual or bulk packing is available, and shipment is arranged according to your confirmed order, destination and payment terms.
